listing.name: Vib-Ribbon / Alexbeav PSXRecomp
listing.summary: PlayStation port of Vib-Ribbon. Portcove can build and update the Windows x64 and Linux x86-64 player with your own disc and BIOS. Mac setup uses the upstream kit.

steps.title: Unpack the stable setup kit
steps.instruction: Extract the complete ZIP for your system into a writable folder. Choose the Intel or Apple silicon ZIP that matches your Mac. Check the release notes for that kit’s prerequisites.

steps.title: Install the build tools
steps.instruction: On Windows, install Python 3. The upstream wizard downloads the build-tool pack on first rebuild. On Linux and Mac, put CMake, Ninja, a supported Python 3 version and a native C/C++ compiler on PATH.

steps.title: Supply the matching original files
steps.instruction: Select your own Vib-Ribbon (Europe) (En,Fr,De,Es,It).cue (SCES-02873) with all 8 referenced BIN tracks. The v0.1.3 kit requires your own 524,288-byte SCPH-5552 (Europe) retail BIOS with SHA-256 1faaa18fa820a0225e488d9f086296b8e6c46df739666093987ff7d8fd352c09.

steps.title: Build and add the completed player
steps.instruction: Run Vib_Ribbon_Recompiled from the kit folder, with .exe on Windows. Choose Generate & rebuild. Select the completed player under build-release in Portcove and use build-release as its start folder.

warnings: Check the README-SETUP.txt inside your exact kit for its BIOS requirement. Older kits can require a different dump. Keep the original files and the working kit together.
Portcove has not verified native setup, gameplay or save compatibility.

references.title: Check Linux and Mac prerequisites
references.instruction: Check the release notes for the kit’s Python version, macOS minimum and required libraries before starting setup. The v0.1.3 kits need Python 3.10 or newer on Linux and Mac. The Mac setup uses Apple clang 15 and needs Homebrew’s OpenSSL, FreeType and HarfBuzz libraries.

references.title: Keep your working copy and data
references.instruction: Make an in-game save and close the player before updating. Back up the whole working folder, including memory cards, settings, keyboard profiles, replays and mods you use. Keep your original disc and BIOS. Save states and replays can depend on the build.

presentation.manual_preparation: Select your own complete 8-track CHD for Vib-Ribbon (Europe, SCES-02873) and your retail SCPH-5552 BIOS. Portcove verifies the first data track and the track count, then builds a private player. The game mounts the complete CHD. Portcove retains the declared saves, replays, settings and installed mods. Bundled mods belong to the runtime version. Runtime rollback carries current player data. Intel and Apple silicon Macs use upstream setup. Native setup, audio playback and gameplay remain unobserved.
